_about: Public-domain J. A. Alexander (Joseph Addison Alexander, 1809-1860, Princeton Seminary professor of Oriental and Biblical literature) for the Word Hoard: the critical Isaiah (The Earlier Prophecies, 1846; The Later Prophecies, 1847), The Psalms Translated and Explained (1850, 3 vols), The Acts of the Apostles Explained (1857, 2 vols), Mark (1858), Matthew (1861), Notes on New Testament Literature (1861) and Sermons (1860, 2 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
